chain_words.nuance: lacking the opportunities or advantages others have
requiring help to meet basic needs
reduced to poverty, often through a loss of resources
having nothing at all, with no means of survival

explanation: These words all describe a lack of wealth or resources, from being disadvantaged in opportunities to having nothing at all.

usage_notes.difference: 'Poor' describes a general state of having little money; 'impoverished' emphasizes that someone has been made poor, often by losing resources over time.
